Empty panel kit / exact content hosts

Generated frame art, measured source cuts, precise reusable layouts. The labels, meters and buttons here are live browser elements. Matching empty Unity prefabs have separate content RectTransforms.

Reference canvas: 1920 x 1080. Panel corners: 32 canvas units, fixed during resizing.

Authored reference dimensions

SurfaceOuter sizeContent hostPadding X / Y
StatusPanel[360, 144][280, 88][40, 28]
FirePanel[320, 112][256, 64][32, 24]
ObjectivePanel[400, 128][336, 80][32, 24]
GuildBoard[1120, 760][1024, 664][48, 48]
ContractCard[448, 520][384, 456][32, 32]
ActionButton[288, 80][224, 40][32, 20]
ContentWell[480, 360][416, 296][32, 32]

Buttons use an 80-unit control height; hit areas and navigation are independent of art alpha. Frames and scripted accents do not intercept input. Production content stays in the clear host, and text retains its own contrast backing.

Supplied icon library | Full layered HUD fixture
